data.headline: Outbreak Alert: Suspected Dengue Cases Rising in Hospital OPD
data.situation: Synthetic demo data: 28-day simulated history plus today's live queue. Total cases stand at 118 with 37 cases this week compared to 29 cases previous week, showing a week-on-week ratio of 1.28 and a doubling time of 19.9 days. Cases include 61 females and 57 males across age bands: <5 (10), 5–14 (23), 15–44 (50), 45–64 (30), and 65+ (5). Localities with active alerts are Dhok Hassu (13 cases this week, usual per week 3.7) and Pirwadhai (12 cases this week, usual per week 2). Top localities also include Satellite Town (3 cases), G-10 (2 cases), and F-6 (2 cases).
recommended_actions: Larval source reduction and fogging in the named localities
Community awareness campaigns on stagnant water removal
Strengthening platelet-monitoring capacity in the hospital
Ensuring proper triage and clinical management for suspected dengue cases
